title: How students at a high school travel to school
bodyMd: A high school surveyed its grade 11 and grade 12 students about how they usually travel to school. Each student chose exactly one of three ways. The table below shows the results.

data.caption: Usual way of traveling to school for the 182 grade 11 and grade 12 students surveyed.

accessibilityText: A two-way table of survey results with rows for grade 11, grade 12 and total, and columns for bus, bicycle, car and total. Grade 11: 42 bus, 18 bicycle, 20 car, 80 in total. Grade 12: 50 bus, 12 bicycle, 40 car, 102 in total. Totals: 92 bus, 30 bicycle, 60 car, 182 students in all.

provenance.notes: Original data set written for this item bank. The counts were chosen so that the conditional probabilities in the question come out as simple fractions.
